verdict_reason: Correct trace-header extraction, but the subscription-key header stays copied in three controllers and the constants belong inside the one function using them.

todos.issue: This PR makes MdmStubResponses the shared home for what every MDM stub answer carries, but the request header the three MDM controllers require stays declared three times as OCP_APIM_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY = "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" (CountriesController.java:20, PortsOfEntryController.java:18, and a new third copy at ProductController.java:26).
todos.fix: Must: the MDM subscription-key header name has one owner that every MDM stub controller uses. One way: a public constant in this class (or a sibling MdmHeaders) imported by the three controllers, with the local copies deleted.

todos.issue: TRACE_HEADER and TRACE_ID (lines 7-8) are module-scope constants used only by withTraceHeader; the house rule puts a literal used by one function inside that function.
todos.fix: Must: the trace header name and value live in withTraceHeader. One way: return response.header("x-ms-middleware-request-id", "stub-trace-id"); and delete the two fields.
